steps.command: set -e; for p in s1-eth1 s1-eth2; do ovs-vsctl set port $p vlan_mode=access tag=10; done; for p in s1-eth3 s1-eth4; do ovs-vsctl set port $p vlan_mode=access tag=20; done
ip addr flush dev h1-eth0; ip addr add 10.10.0.1/24 dev h1-eth0; ip link set h1-eth0 up
ip addr flush dev h2-eth0; ip addr add 10.10.0.2/24 dev h2-eth0; ip link set h2-eth0 up
ip addr flush dev h3-eth0; ip addr add 10.10.0.3/24 dev h3-eth0; ip link set h3-eth0 up
ip addr flush dev h4-eth0; ip addr add 10.10.0.4/24 dev h4-eth0; ip link set h4-eth0 up
ping -c 1 -W 2 10.10.0.3; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then echo "VLAN isolation check failed (ping exit $rc)" >&2; exit 1; fi
ping -c 1 -W 2 10.10.0.1; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then echo "VLAN isolation check failed (ping exit $rc)" >&2; exit 1; fi
